job.title: HR Truck Drivers - Waste Collection
job.description:
We are currently seeking experienced HR Waste Collection Drivers to join a fast-paced, high-performing operation servicing major Brisbane City Council contracts across Brisbane. This is a casual ongoing opportunity with consistent full-time hours, strong earning potential, and genuine temp-to-perm pathway available for reliable, safety-focused drivers.

What’s on offer:

  • Casual on-going position
  • Genuine view to a permanent position
  • $44.31 per hour ordinary time
  • $56.72 per hour time & a half
  • $74.44 per hour double time
  • 12-hour night shifts from 12am – 12pm
  • Double time from 12am–2am
  • Time & a half from 2am–4am

About the role:

  • Operating rear lift or front lift waste trucks
  • Commercial waste collection throughout Brisbane metro areas
  • Completing pre-start and post-start vehicle checks
  • Maintaining NHVR driving hours and fatigue compliance
  • Manual handling including pushing and pulling bins
  • Communicating professionally with the public and stakeholders
  • Working long 12-hour night shifts in a safety-focused environment

About you:

  • HR licence with minimum 1 year experience in a similar role
  • Previous waste industry experience is highly desirable
  • Rear lift truck experience preferred
  • Strong commitment to road safety and safe work practices
  • Experience with multidrop driving in large vehicles
  • Good knowledge of Brisbane / South-East QLD routes advantageous
  • Reliable attitude and strong work ethic

To be successful, candidates must also be willing to complete a full pre-employment medical, police check, drug & alcohol testing, and provide a current driving history report. Successful applicants will also be required to complete HEPA, HEPB, and Q-Fever vaccinations as part of onboarding.

This site has high expectations around safety, reliability, and performance. Candidates must be professional, hardworking, and able to work in a fast-paced environment where quality and consistency are essential.

Apply now to secure your opportunity with a leading operation offering ongoing work, excellent pay rates, and genuine long-term career potential.
